name: Karate
summary: API testing in a Gherkin-style DSL on the JVM, with built-in mocks, parallel execution and reuse of tests for performance runs.
strengths: Tests read like specifications without Java glue code.
API tests, mocks and parallel runs in one tool.
tradeoffs: A custom DSL that developers may resist.
Complex logic is awkward compared to a general-purpose language.
Runs on the JVM even if your services do not.
